serial.description: ChaosKey device serial number. If empty, uses the first available device.

data_length.description: Amount of data to read. Supports suffixes k, M, G (e.g., '1k', '2M').

infinite.description: If true, reads data indefinitely until process is killed.

output_mode.description: Selects the source endpoint: 'raw' (default, raw RNG), 'cooked' (kernel-trimmed), 'bytes' (16-bit → 8-bit), or 'firmware' (device firmware).
